20601.meaning1: is not worth a fraction; does not amount to a sixteenth part (of)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yā kāci tārakarūpānaṃ pabhā, sabbā tā candappabhāya kalaṃ n'āgghanti soḷasiṃ, candappabhā tāsaṃ aggam'akkhāyati
ārāmacetyā vanacetyā, pokkharañño sunimmitā, manussarāmaṇeyyassa, kalaṃ n'āgghanti soḷasiṃ.

20602.commentary: (SNa) kalaṃ nāma soḷasabhāgo'pi satabhāgo'pi sahassabhāgo'pi. idha satabhāgo gahito.

examples.text: māse māse kus'aggena, bālo bhuñjeyya bhojanaṃ, na so saṅkhātadhammānaṃ, kalaṃ agghati soḷasiṃ.
saṅkham'pi na upeti upanidhim'pi na upeti kalabhāgam'pi na upeti mahāpathaviṃ upanidhāya bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito'ti.
sevamāno sevamānaṃ, samphuṭṭho samphusaṃ paraṃ, saro diddho kalāpaṃ'va, alittam'upalimpati, upalepabhayā dhīro, n'eva pāpasakhā siyā.
asi ca cammañ'ca asicammaṃ, dhanu ca kalāpo ca dhanukalāpaṃ, hatthī ca asso ca hatthi-assaṃ, ratho ca pattiko ca rathapattikaṃ. evaṃ sen'aṅg'atthe.
sādhu me, bhante, ayyo mahako uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassetū'ti. tena hi tvaṃ, gahapati, ālinde uttar'āsaṅgaṃ paññapetvā tiṇakalāpaṃ okāsehī'ti.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yavakalāpī cātumahāpathe nikkhittā assa. atha cha purisā āgaccheyyuṃ byābhaṅgihatthā. te yavakalāpiṃ chahi byābhaṅgīhi haneyyuṃ. evañ'hi sā, bhikkhave, yavakalāpī suhatā assa chahi byābhaṅgīhi haññamānā.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, dve naḷakalāpiyo aññam'aññaṃ nissāya tiṭṭheyyuṃ. evam'eva kho, āvuso, nāmarūpapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ

20609.meaning2: who has a quiver or a bundle

examples.text: acirapakkantassa ca kokālikassa bhikkhuno sāsapamattīhi pīḷakāhi sabbo kāyo phuṭo ahosi. sāsapamattiyo hutvā muggamattiyo ahesuṃ, muggamattiyo hutvā kalāyamattiyo ahesuṃ, kalāyamattiyo hutvā kol'aṭṭhimattiyo ahesuṃ
yo nindiyaṃ pasaṃsati, taṃ vā nindati yo pasaṃsiyo vicināti mukhena so kaliṃ, kalinā tena sukhaṃ na vindati.
sudassaṃ vajjam'aññesaṃ, attano pana duddasaṃ, paresaṃ hi so vajjāni, opunāti yathā bhusaṃ, attano pana chādeti, kaliṃ'va kitavā saṭho.

20616.commentary: (ANa) taṃ mam'assa kalī'ti taṃ vacanaṃ mayhaṃ doso bhaveyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: yaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tam'ahaṃ n'eva jānāmi na na jānāmī'ti vadeyyaṃ, taṃ mam'assa kali.
n'atthi rāgasamo aggi, n'atthi dosasamo kali, n'atthi khandhasamā dukkhā, n'atthi santiparaṃ sukhaṃ.

20617.notes: (MW) name of the die or side of a die marked with one dot, the losing die

examples.text: sace kho atth'eva kiriyā, evaṃ imassa bhoto purisapuggalassa ubhay'attha kaliggaho, yañ'ca diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ gārayho, yañ'ca kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjissati.

sace kho atth'eva paro loko, evaṃ imassa bhoto purisapuggalassa ubhay'attha kaliggaho, yañ'ca diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ gārayho, yañ'ca kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjissati.

20620.commentary: (ANa) ubhay'attha kaliggāho'ti idhaloke ca paraloke cā'ti ubhayasmim'pi aparaddhaggāho, parājayaggāho hotī'ti attho. atha vā ubhay'attha kaliggāho'ti ubhay'esam'pi diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikānaṃ atthānaṃ kaliggāho, parājayaggāho'ti attho.

examples.text: na c'eva bhogā tathārūpā, na ca puññāni kubbati, ubhay'attha kaliggāho, andhassa hatacakkhuno.

20621.commentary: (APt) kala sadde, iṅgapaccayo, kaliṅgā, tesaṃ nivāso kaliṅgā, uttar'āpatho, kaliṃ gaṇhantī'ti vā kaliṅgā, kvi, kalaṃ madhurasaddaṃ gāyantī'tivā kaliṅgā, assittaṃ, kena sukhena liṅgantī'ti vā kaliṅgā, liṅga gaman'attho daṇḍako dhātu.

examples.text: evam'etesu ekādasasu janesu kurudhammaṃ rakkhantesu kaliṅgaraṭṭhe dantapuranagare kaliṅge rajjaṃ kārente tasmiṃ raṭṭhe devo na vassi. mahāsattassa pana añjanasannibho nāma maṅgalahatthī mahāpuñño hoti.

20622.meaning2: log, rotten piece of wood, chaff

examples.text: kaliṅgara-upadhānā, bhikkhave, eta'r'ahi licchavī viharanti appamattā ātāpino upāsanasmiṃ. tesaṃ rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto na labhati otāraṃ na labhati ārammaṇaṃ.

20623.meaning2: log, rotten piece of wood, chaff

examples.text: aciraṃ vat'ayaṃ kāyo, pathaviṃ adhisessati, chuddho apetaviññāṇo, niratthaṃ'va kaliṅgaraṃ.

20624.sanskrit: kaliñja, kiliñja, kaḍaṅgara, kaḍaṃkara + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

examples.text: kaliṅgar'ūpadhānā, bhikkhave, eta'r'ahi licchavī viharanti appamattā ātāpino upāsanasmiṃ. tesaṃ rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto na labhati otāraṃ na labhati ārammaṇaṃ.

20626.meaning2: age of vice and misery; i.e. the last of the four period of an aeon

20627.meaning1: like what is called bad luck, a great failure

examples.text: yathā iṇan'ti-ādīsu iṇasadisaṃ bandhanasadisaṃ dhanajānisadisaṃ kalisaṅkhāta-mah'āparādha-sadisañ'ca katvā attano abhimukhassa patodassa ajjhoharaṇasaṅkhātaṃ patanaṃ vipassatī'ti attho.

20628.commentary: (VINa) kalisāsanaṃ āropetī'ti kalī'ti kodho, tassa sāsanaṃ āropeti, kodhassa āṇaṃ āropeti, kodhavasena ṭhānanisajj'ādīsu dosaṃ dassetvā passatha bho imassa ṭhānaṃ, nisajjaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ khāṇuko viya tiṭṭhati, sunakho viya nisīdati, makkaṭo viya ito c'ito ca viloketī'ti evaṃ amanāpavacanaṃ vadati app'eva nāma iminā'pi ubbāḷho pakkameyyā'ti.

examples.text: anupasampannaṃ uyyojeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. kalisāsanaṃ āropeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. anupasampanne upasampannasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

20629.meaning2: losing dice; bad luck; defeat; disaster

20630.meaning2: soft part above the steam of a palm tree

20636.meaning1: healthy; happy; sound; fit; in good spirits
20636.meaning2: healthy; sound; fit; in good spirits

examples.text: disvāna deve muditamane udagge, cittiṃ karitvāna idam'avoca tattha, kiṃ devasaṅgho atiriva kalyarūpo, dussaṃ gahetvā ramayatha kiṃ paṭicca.
nagā nag'aggesu susaṃvirūḷhā, udaggameghena navena sittā, vivekakāmassa araññasaññino, janeti bhiyyo usabhassa kalyatan'ti.

20638.meaning2: skilled or proficient in regard to well being, to fitness, to readiness

20639.meaning1: good; favourable; propitious; beneficial; beautiful; lovely; ethical
20639.synonym: abhirūpa, kusala, cāru, bhadraka, vaggu, vasu, sundara, sumaṅgala, hita

examples.text: kammassako'mhi kammadāy'ādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā tassa dāy'ādo bhavissāmī'ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
kiñ'c'āpi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, kalyāṇamitto purisapuggalo kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko'ti.

20640.meaning1: (of speech) polite; kind; charming; (comm) soft and gentle

examples.text: kim'atthakāmo na dade, kiṃ macco na pariccaje, kiṃsu muñceyya kalyāṇaṃ, pāpikaṃ na ca mocaye'ti.
attānaṃ na dade poso, attānaṃ na pariccaje, vācaṃ muñceyya kalyāṇaṃ, pāpikañ'ca na mocaye'ti.

20641.meaning1: goodness; good deeds; virtue; merit; benefit; quality

examples.text: abhittharetha kalyāṇe, pāpā cittaṃ nivāraye, dandhañ'hi karoto puññaṃ, pāpasmiṃ ramatī mano.
paññaṃ purakkhatvā kalyāṇapīti, vikkhambhaye tāni parissayāni, aratiṃ sahetha sayanamhi pante, caturo sahetha paridevadhamme.

20642.meaning1: good deed; beneficial action; act of kindness

examples.text: api ca, mahārāja, katamena taṃ nemi, yena vā pāpakammā pāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, yena vā kalyāṇakammā kalyāṇakammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī'ti? ubhayen'eva maṃ, mātali, nehī'ti.
ayaṃ varāko kiñ'c'āpi idāni sukhito susajjito bhoge paribhuñjati, atha kho tīsu dvāresu ekenā'pi katassa kalyāṇakammassa abhāvā idāni apāyesu anappakaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedissatī'ti.

20643.meaning1: desire for something good; wanting something of quality
20643.commentary: (VINa) kalyāṇakamyataṃ upādāyā'ti sundarakāmataṃ visiṭṭhakāmataṃ cittena gahetvā, tassa āpajjeyya ce'ti iminā sambandho.

examples.text: sādhu vata maṃ āyasmā iminā cīvaracetāpannena evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā acchādehī'ti kalyāṇakamyataṃ upādāya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

20644.meaning1: wanting the best (in); desiring the finest

examples.text: bhavissanti, bhikkhave, bhikkhū anāgatam'addhānaṃ cīvare kalyāṇakāmā. te cīvare kalyāṇakāmā samānā riñcissanti paṃsukūlikattaṃ, riñcissanti araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni, gāmanigamarājadhānīsu osaritvā vāsaṃ kappessanti, cīvarahetu ca anekavihitaṃ anesanaṃ appatirūpaṃ āpajjissanti.

20645.meaning1: who does what is good; doing what is beneficial; who is virtuous
20645.commentary: (NPt) yādisaṃ yaṃ bījaṃ vapate, taṃ bījaṃ tādisaṃ phalaṃ harate iva, tathā kalyāṇakārī paṇḍito kalyāṇaṃ phalaṃ harate, pāpakārī bālo ca pāpakaṃ phalaṃ harate'ti yojanā.

examples.text: sakaṃ nivesanaṃ pattaṃ, yo taṃ brāhmaṇa pūjayi, evaṃ kalyāṇakārissa, kiṃ mohā dubbhim'icchasi.
yāsu kāsuci etāsu, danto jāyati puṅgavo, dhorayho balasampanno, kalyāṇajavanikkamo, tam'eva bhāre yuñjanti, n'āssa vaṇṇaṃ parikkhare.
pāpañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi, pāpena pāpatarañ'ca, kalyāṇañ'ca, kalyāṇena kalyāṇatarañ'ca. taṃ suṇātha ….

20649.commentary: (THa) dassanīyarūpatāya aṅgīgatānaṃ dassanasampattīnaṃ āvahanato, kalyāṇehi pañcahi dassanehi samannāgatattā ca kalyāṇadassano

examples.text: kalyāṇadassano bhikkhu, kañcanasannibhattaco, kiṃ te samaṇabhāvena, evaṃ uttamavaṇṇino.
sace, bhikkhave, sattā diṭṭhadhamm'ūpakkamahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, addhā, bhikkhave, tathāgato kalyāṇadiṭṭhadhamm'ūpakkamo yaṃ eta'r'ahi evarūpā anāsavā sukhā vedanā vedeti.

20651.meaning1: good-natured; upright nature; of solid character; virtuous
20651.commentary: (VIN 1.2.4) kalyāṇadhammo nāma tena ca sīlena tena ca brahmacariyena kalyāṇadhammo hoti.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ bhagini pāricariyānaṃ yā mādisaṃ sīlavantaṃ kalyāṇadhammaṃ brahmacāriṃ etena dhammena paricareyyā'ti methun'upasaṃhitena, saṅgh'ādiseso.
katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo.

20653.meaning1: better-natured; of more upright character; more virtuous (than)

examples.text: pāpadhammañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi, pāpadhammena pāpadhammatarañ'ca, kalyāṇadhammañ'ca, kalyāṇadhammena kalyāṇadhammatarañ'ca. taṃ suṇātha ….

20654.meaning1: fact of having good qualities; fact of having good principles; virtuousness
20654.commentary: (ANa) ariye ñāye'ti sahavipassanake magge. kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā'ti'pi tass'eva nāmāni.

examples.text: idha, brāhmaṇa, bahujanahitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanasukhāya, bahussa janatā ariye ñāye patiṭṭhāpitā, yadidaṃ kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā.

20655.meaning1: of good understanding; of excellent wisdom
20655.commentary: (ITIa) kalyāṇapañño'ti ca maggaphalapaññāvasen'eva kalyāṇapañño. lok'uttarā eva hi sīl'ādidhammā ek'antakalyāṇā nāma akuppasabhāvattā. keci pana catupārisuddhisīlavasena kalyāṇasīlo, vipassanāmaggadhammavasena kalyāṇadhammo, maggaphalapaññāvasena kalyāṇapañño'ti vadanti. asekkhā eva te sīladhammapaññā'ti eke. (THa) kalyāṇapañño'ti sundarapañño.

examples.text: kalyāṇapañño ca kathaṃ hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.

20657.commentary: (DNa) kalyāṇapaṭibhāno'ti vākkaraṇasampanno c'eva hoti paṭibhānasampanno ca. yuttapaṭibhāno kho pana hoti no muttapaṭibhāno. sīlasamācārasmiñ'hi ṭhitabhikkhu muttapaṭibhāno na hoti, yuttapaṭibhāno pana hoti vaṅg'īsatthero viya.

examples.text: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ kaccānaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato, paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī bahussuto cittakathī kalyāṇapaṭibhāno vuddho c'eva arahā ca. sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī'ti.

20658.meaning1: good and bad; good and evil

examples.text: atha vā pan'assa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti, yo me ayaṃ attā vado vedeyyo tatra tatra kalyāṇapāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti so kho pana me ayaṃ attā nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassatī'ti
paññaṃ purakkhatvā kalyāṇapīti, vikkhambhaye tāni parissayāni, aratiṃ sahetha sayanamhi pante, caturo sahetha paridevadhamme.

20660.meaning2: finding joy in what is good

20661.meaning2: magnanimous ordinary man (i.e. who has not attained a path but is practising for it)

examples.text: dīghā jaṅghā yassa so'yaṃ dīghajaṅgho, kalyāṇabhariyo, pahūtapañño.

20664.meaning1: did good; performed good deeds; made merit (by)

examples.text: tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, yamo rājā evam'āha, ambho purisa, pamādavatāya na kalyāṇam'akāsi kāyena vācāya manasā. taggha tvaṃ, ambho purisa, tathā karissanti yathā taṃ pamattaṃ.

20665.meaning1: with excellent friends; with good spiritual companions

examples.text: kalyāṇamitto, bhikkhave, bhikkhu akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāvetī'ti. etam'atthaṃ bhagavā avoca. tatth'etaṃ iti vuccati
kiñ'c'āpi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, kalyāṇamitto purisapuggalo kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko'ti.
kalyāṇamittatā muninā, lokaṃ ādissa vaṇṇitā, kalyāṇamitte bhajamāno, api bālo paṇḍito assa.

20667.meaning1: fact of having excellent friendship; fact of having spiritual companionship
20667.commentary: (DNa) sovacassatā ca kalyāṇamittatā ca vuttappaṭipakkhanayena veditabbā. ubho'pi pan'etā idha lokiyalok'uttara-missakā kathitā. (SNa) yadidaṃ kalyāṇamittatā'ti yā esā kalyāṇamittatā nāma, sā upaḍḍhaṃ, tato upaḍḍhaṃ āgacchatī'ti attho. iti therena upaḍḍh'upaḍḍhā sammādiṭṭhi'ādayo kalyāṇamittato āgacchanti, upaḍḍh'upaḍḍhā paccattapurisakārato'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: uṭṭhānaṃ anālasyaṃ bhogānaṃ āhāro, maṇḍanā vibhūsanā vaṇṇassa āhāro, sappāyakiriyā ārogyassa āhāro, kalyāṇamittatā sīlānaṃ āhāro
kalyāṇamittatā muninā, lokaṃ ādissa vaṇṇitā, kalyāṇamitte bhajamāno, api bālo paṇḍito assa.

20675.meaning1: for (a monk) having good friends this

examples.text: kalyāṇamittass'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa, sīlavā bhavissati
kalyāṇamittass'etaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa, ariyaṃ aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati, ariyaṃ aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissati.

20677.meaning1: having good circumstances; fortunate; blessed; well-fated

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, sattā saṅgatibhāvahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, addhā, bhikkhave, tathāgato kalyāṇasaṅgatiko yaṃ eta'r'ahi evarūpā anāsavā sukhā vedanā vedeti.

20678.meaning2: having good fortune; fortunate in fate

20679.meaning1: with good associates; having good companions

examples.text: rājā, bhikkhave, māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto pāpamitto pāpasahāyo pāpasampavaṅko, rājā ca kho, bhikkhave, pasenadi kosalo kalyāṇamitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko.
kiñ'c'āpi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, kalyāṇamitto purisapuggalo kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko'ti.

20680.meaning1: fact of having good associates; fact of having good companions

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, upaḍḍham'idaṃ, bhante, brahmacariyaṃ, yadidaṃ, kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā'ti.

20681.meaning1: with good companions; having good friends

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto hoti kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko. sambodhipakkhikānaṃ, āvuso, dhammānaṃ ayaṃ paṭhamā upanisā bhāvanāya.
kiñ'c'āpi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, kalyāṇamitto purisapuggalo kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko'ti.

20682.meaning1: fact of having good companions; fact of having good friends

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, upaḍḍham'idaṃ, bhante, brahmacariyaṃ, yadidaṃ, kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā'ti.

20683.commentary: (ITIa) kalyāṇasīlo'ti sundarasīlo, pasatthasīlo, paripuṇṇasīlo. tattha sīlapāripūrī dvīhi kāraṇehi hoti samma'd'eva sīlavipattiyā ādīnavadassanena, sīlasampattiyā ca ānisaṃsadassanena. idha pana sabbaparibandhavippamuttassa sabbākāraparipuṇṇassa maggasīlassa phalasīlassa ca vasena kalyāṇatā veditabbā.

examples.text: upasanto anāyāso, vippasanno anāvilo, kalyāṇasīlo medhāvī, dukkhass'antakaro siyā.
kalyāṇasīlo, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kalyāṇadhammo kalyāṇapañño imasmiṃ dhammavinaye kevalī vusitavā uttamapuriso'ti vuccati

20685.commentary: (MNa) kalyāṇaṃ madhuraṃ vākkaraṇaṃ assā'ti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo. vākkaraṇan'ti udāharaṇaghoso. (ANa) kalyāṇavākkaraṇānan'ti vākkaraṇaṃ vuccati vacanakiriyā, madhuravacanānan'ti attho. ayañ'hi thero dasabalena saddhiṃ ekagandhakuṭiyā tathāgatassa madhurena sarena dhammakathaṃ kathesi. ath'assa satthā sādhukāraṃ adāsi. tasmā so kalyāṇavākkaraṇānaṃ aggo nāma jāto.

examples.text: bahussuto ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, kalyāṇavākkaraṇo ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, paṇḍito ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo, pahoti ca soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetun'ti
no ca kalyāṇavāco hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā

addham'idaṃ, bhikkhave, lābhānaṃ yadidaṃ āraññikattaṃ … piṇḍapātikattaṃ… paṃsukūlikattaṃ… tecīvarikattaṃ… dhammakathikattaṃ… vinayadharattaṃ … bāhusaccaṃ… thāvareyyaṃ… ākappasampadā… parivārasampadā… mahāparivāratā… kolaputti… vaṇṇapokkharatā… kalyāṇavākkaraṇatā… app'icchatā… appābādhatā'ti.
no ca kalyāṇavāco hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā

20688.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of kalyāṇa
20688.commentary: (SNa) kalyāṇaṃ vuccatī'ti catūhi paccayehi paṭijaggissāmī'ti vacanaṃ niddosaṃ anavajjaṃ vuccati tayā upāsakā'ti adhippāyena vadati.

examples.text: ahaṃ ayyassa mahakassa ussukkaṃ karissāmi cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārānan'ti. kalyāṇaṃ vuccati, gahapatī'ti.

20691.meaning1: with good disposition; with an ethical inclination
20691.meaning2: whose inclinations are good; intent on good
20691.commentary: (SNa) hīn'ādhimuttikā'ti hīn'ajjhāsayā. kalyāṇ'ādhimuttikā'ti kalyāṇ'ajjhāsayā. (ITIa) kalyāṇ'ādhimuttikā'ti kalyāṇe nekkhamm'ādike adhimutti etesan'ti kalyāṇ'ādhimuttikā, paṇīt'ajjhāsayā.

examples.text: hīn'ādhimuttikā hīn'ādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti, kalyāṇ'ādhimuttikā kalyāṇ'ādhimuttikehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti.
sace, bhikkhave, sattā abhijātihetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, addhā, bhikkhave, tathāgato kalyāṇ'ābhijātiko yaṃ eta'r'ahi evarūpā anāsavā sukhā vedanā vedeti.

20693.grammar: adj, fem nom sg of kalyāṇa

examples.text: sādhu sādhu, bhikkhu! bhaddako kho te, bhikkhu, ummaggo, bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ, kalyāṇī paripucchā

20694.commentary: (DNa) janapadakalyāṇī'ti janapade aññāhi itthīhi vaṇṇasaṇṭhānavilāsākapp'ādīhi asadisā. (UDa) janapadakalyāṇī'ti janapadamhi kalyāṇī rūpena uttamā chasarīradosarahitā, pañcakalyāṇasamannāgatā. sā hi yasmā n'ātidīghā n'ātirassā n'ātikisā n'ātithūlā n'ātikāḷikā n'accodātā atikkantā mānusakavaṇṇaṃ appattā dibbavaṇṇaṃ, tasmā chasarīradosarahitā. chavikalyāṇaṃ maṃsakalyāṇaṃ nakhakalyāṇaṃ aṭṭhikalyāṇaṃ vayakalyāṇan'ti imehi pañcahi kalyāṇehi samannāgatā.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, poṭṭhapāda, puriso evaṃ vadeyya, ahaṃ yā imasmiṃ janapade janapadakalyāṇī, taṃ icchāmi taṃ kāmemī'ti.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, nanda, katamā nu kho abhirūpatarā vā dassanīyatarā vā pāsādikatarā vā, sākiyānī vā janapadakalyāṇī, imāni vā pañca accharāsatāni kakuṭapādānī'ti?

20695.meaning2: name of a river and a town in Sri Lanka
